payload.text: After the 2.14.1 cut, in order, nothing pushed to main while the core waits on CI: (1) utilz-cc: tools/formula-bump 2.14.1, commit by path, copy the formula into the tap clone, brew audit --strict; the tap commit and push are hv's. (2) vc: the signed Menuz.app.zip from a clean worktree at the tag (app-sign, app-notarize, app-verify, publish), booked heavy with gtools-vc. (3) utilz-dc, after hv's tap push: brew upgrade utilz here, utilz doctor, the app from the release asset, and done.md's entry from its tmp/ draft. (4) kovacs, through kovacs-sysadm, each step at hv's approval in its session: check out the 2.14.1 tag in ~/Devel/prj/Utilz, utilz doctor, check that ~/bin's expz, prez, stampz and todo resolve into it; no brew, since the formula is macOS-only, and no utilz use or relink there, since 0079 would link every utility. (5) 0075: utilz menuz status reads the login item on the final install, then hv logs out and in once. (6) vc's globalfold: wip.md, restart.md, done.md.
